ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weather its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
